DeploymentPlanElementName.description: The name of a plan element (group, action). Maximum 60 characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

DeploymentPlanGroupDependency.description: Represents a dependency of a group.

groupName.description: The name of the group to depend on.

DeploymentPlanActionDependency.description: Represents a dependency of an action.

actionName.description: The name of the action to depend on.

DeploymentPlanAction.description: Represents an action in a deployment group.

name.description: The name of the action. Action names must be unique (case-insensitive) in the scope of the group.

job.description: The configuration of the job to execute.

dependsOn.description: The dependencies on other actions within the same group.

DeploymentPlanGroupOption.description: Represents an option in a deployment group. Use a single-name object such as { "ActiveValueSet": "Default value set" } where the option name contains only English letters (max 64) and the value is up to 256 characters.

DeploymentPlanJobParameterName.description: The name of a parameter for a job action. Maximum 255 characters, must start with a letter, no whitespaces, underscore and dashes allowed.

DeploymentPlanJobParameter.description: Represents a parameter for a job action.

DeploymentPlanJob.description: The job configuration for a deployment action.

itemId.description: The Id of the item that implements the job to execute.

logicalId.description: The logical Id of the item that implements the job to execute.

DeploymentPlanGroup.description: Represents a group of items with their deployment configuration.

name.description: The name of the group. Must be unique (case-insensitive) in the scope of the plan.

logicalId.description: The logical Id of the item to import.

preActions.description: The actions to run before importing this group.

postActions.description: The actions to run after importing this group.
